enchantments.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to Armor Class, attack and damage rolls.
Murderous Spikes: On hit: 16d6 Piercing Damage. This item is considered Metalline, bypassing all kinds of material damage resistance.

Revel in Blood (Shield): Your weapon hungers to let blood flow. Your attacks and offensive spells have a high chance to deal very strong Bane damage over time to creatures vulnerable to Bleeding. +24% Enhancement Bonus to Shield Bashing.
Lamordia: Melancholic Slot (Weapon):Apply a Lamordia augment to this item.
Lamordia: Dolorous Slot (Weapon):Apply a Lamordia augment to this item.

enchantments.text: Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4 and/or Mythic Shield Boost +2 or +4
